name: Heavy Bag Rounds
description: 2 min on, 1 min off. Mix jabs, crosses, hooks, body shots. Stay light on your feet.

name: Treadmill Hill Intervals
description: Warm up 5 min. Then 30 sec hard at 8-10% incline, 90 sec easy walk.

name: Kettlebell Circuit
description: 10 swings, 8 goblet squats, 6 presses each arm, 10 push-ups. Rest 60 sec.

name: Run Intervals
description: Jog 5 min easy. Then 2 min hard steady pace, 2 min easy jog or walk.

name: Bag + Swing Combo
description: 1 min hard on the bag, 15 KB swings, rest the rest of the 3 min.

name: Dumbbell Grinder
description: 8 DB thrusters, 10 renegade rows (5 each arm), 10 push-ups. Rest 60 sec.
